description: A photograph depicting a natural waterfall cascading into a wide, flowing river or stream. The waterfall, located on the left, shows a substantial volume of white water descending from a vegetated rocky outcrop. The river below exhibits clear, blue-green water with visible ripples and areas of foam where the waterfall's impact disturbs the surface. Both banks of the river are densely covered with lush green vegetation, including trees and aquatic plants, signifying a natural or semi-natural water course environment. The scene is well-lit, highlighting the water and surrounding foliage.
